Date: 19th October, 2026
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

Megamont Limited Bags Rs. 6.04 Crores Worth Orders to Supply to
AWL Agri Business Limited
Mumbai, 19th October, 2026: Megamont Limited has bagged orders worth Rs. 6.04 Crores to supply Crude
Degummed

Soyabean Oil to AWL

Agri Business Limited (formerly Adani Wilmar Limited). The entire

supply is to be executed within October 2026.

Details of the Orders:
Megamont Limited will supply Crude Degummed Soyabean Oil to AWL Agri Business Limited at its facility in
Surat, Gujarat. Supplies against the orders have already commenced, with dispatches made on 16th and
17th October, 2026, and the balance quantity will be delivered within October 2026.
The orders are being executed in multiple consignments by road, and the short delivery window reflects the
company'’s ability to source, move and deliver bulk edible oil on a tight timeline.

Strategic Significance:
AWL Agri Business Limited is one of India’s leading food and FMCG companies and a large buyer of edible
oils. Orders of this size to supply such a customer, to be executed in a single month, validate Megamont’s
execution capability and strengthen its position as a dependable bulk supplier.
The orders add to the company’s relationship with a marquee

customer

and open the door to repeat

business as Megamont continues to expand its presence in the edible oil and agri-commodity segment.

Industry Outlook:
India is among the world's largest consumers and importers of edible oils, and soyabean oil is a core part of
the country’s edible oil basket. Demand from packaged food makers, refiners and household consumers
remains steady, and large refiners depend

on reliable, on-time bulk sourcing of crude oils. Against this

backdrop, a supplier that can deliver quality product on schedule is well placed to build lasting relationships
with leading buyers.

Mr. Tejas Patil, Director, Megamont

“We are pleased to have bagged these

orders to supply AWL Agri Business Limited. The supplies are to be executed fully in October 2026 and

We will continue to look for opportunities to grow our business with leading customers.”

About Megamont Limited:
Megamont Limited is an international trading and supply-chain company engaged in sourcing and supplying
industrial raw materials, metals, energy commodities, edible oils and agricultural commodities across global
markets.

The

company

operates

across

diverse

product

portfolios,

including

edible

oils

and

agri

commodities, metals and mining resources, building materials, industrial chemicals and rubber, machinery
and equipment, electronics and technology, and energy and petrochemical products.
With sourcing relationships across India, CIS, China, Brazil, South Africa, Russia and Europe, Megamont
combines

sourcing, trade structuring, trade finance, logistics and

risk management

to connect global

producers with industrial and commercial buyers.
